annotations.title: Suggest visual styles for a clip

description: Use this when the person asks to see Slice's style library, and only then. When someone wants visuals or animation and has no style, design your own looks for the clip first (owner, 1 November 2026: the library is being reworked); never list library styles in the chat unasked. With a library request: Pass the words as text, or a clip_id, job_id or episode_id from Slice to use its transcript. Returns a few ranked styles from the Slice library with a short reason each, plus the whole catalogue so you can choose with your own judgement. Show the person 3 to 5 options with the reasons and let them choose. They can mix styles or use none: there is no need to use a Slice style at all.

aspect.description: The frame shape, if known. Every style works in every shape; this only breaks ties.

clip_id.description: Instead of text: a Slice clip's clip_id, to use its words.

episode_id.description: Instead of text: a Slice episode_id, to use the episode's words.

job_id.description: Instead of text: the job_id of a clip being made or rendered, to use its words.

text.description: A transcript, a script or a description of the clip, up to 20,000 characters.

name: suggest_visual_styles
